recommendation: Keep the no-change audit. Do not revert the current 763158003 medication/product root to the older 410942007 wording solely for FHIR-8022; the seed's required correction was removing the route-code value set, and later source history explains the current refined exemplar.
issue_request: FHIR-8022 was a Published/Persuasive Pharmacy change request from the 2015 May DSTU1 ballot. It reported that the value set linked from Medication.code appeared to contain route codes and requested updating it to medication codes; the resolution directed the binding to SNOMED CT medication concepts, stated then as concept is-a 410942007.
initial_application: Historical source shows the defect was applied: commit 6ce87fde09500c2d61c86a07ac98f49037e7d747 changed valueset-medication-codes.xml from SNOMED CT route-of-administration concept 284009009 to 410942007. The duplicate FHIR-8064 records the same Medication.code correction, and commit 534313123abc479f1c95a22956d9992582f9743c lists FHIR-8022 in the same 2015 medication ballot-change family.
additional_context: Medication is active in the current build via source/fhir.ini. Later Pharmacy terminology history refined the medication-code exemplar: FHIR-8435 broadened medication-code bindings, and commit 51ce8a822f639be478cea8655beab71f95afb6ab changed the exemplar to SNOMED CT concept is-a 763158003. That later root differs from the 2015 wording but remains medication/product terminology and does not reintroduce route codes.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current source/medication/structuredefinition-Medication.xml binds Medication.code to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/medication-codes, and current source/medication/valueset-medication-codes.xml defines that value set using SNOMED CT medicinal product concept is-a 763158003.
